messages:
ana: Quick ask — running a short smoke to check onprem config drift vs hosted perf. Seeing ~12% p95 token latency delta for chat-small. Anyone able to run a parity smoke on dc3 racks?

sam: which image + config did you test with?

ana: image `redwood/infer:prod-2026-03-13`, config: stable, batch=8, seq=512. Ran on dc3-r5-12 and compared to hosted in us-west1.

matt: ping infra — I'll kick off fio/iperf/eth checks on dc3-r5. tagging @lina in case network knobs are needed.

infra-bot: @matt triggered job `parity-smoke/1716234567` on dc3-r5 (steps: fio -> iperf3 -> ethtool dump -> dmesg collect). Logs will land in /mnt/artifacts/1716234567/ when done.

lina: quick thought: did you change NIC offloads or kernel tx/rx settings? small defaults can cause tail spikes on heavy small-payload bursts.

ana: nothing intentional. here's the fio command I used locally as reference:
```
fio --name=randread --filename=/dev/nvme0n1 --direct=1 --bs=4k --iodepth=32 --size=1G --numjobs=4 --runtime=60
```

sam: can you also paste `cat /proc/interrupts`, `ethtool -k eth0`, and `nvidia-smi topo -m` outputs? will help narrow NIC vs GPU.

matt: uploaded raw outputs to /mnt/artifacts/1716234567/raw.txt. quick summary: NVMe latencies look fine, `ethtool -k` shows tso/gso on, `cat /proc/interrupts` not skewed, but observed CPU steal 3-5% during runs.

ana: hmmm steal on baremetal? these nodes are baremetal but shared at cabinet level — any migrations or noisy neighbors noted?

matt: confirmed baremetal, but BIOS C-state profile was on 'auto'. I applied the BIOS patch to set C-states to "performance" and reran. p95 improved ~6% but there's still a ~6% residual gap vs hosted.

lina: can we try disabling deep C-states + isolcpus for the perf cpu set and turn off irqbalance on the canary node? If latency gap persists after that, we should collect perf.data and a kernel trace (ftrace) to look for scheduling/irq stalls.

sam: I'll queue a canary on dc3-r5-12 with: C-state off, `isolcpus=2-7`, `irqaffinity` pinned, irqbalance disabled. ETA ~45m for run + upload.

infra-bot: parity-smoke job finished for canary (job id 1716234567-1). Results: /mnt/artifacts/1716234567/result.json, flamegraphs at /mnt/artifacts/1716234567/flamegraphs/.

ana: thanks — if canary still shows the delta I'll open a perf-side PR with perf.data and flamegraphs attached. Also plan to run model-level KV cache instrumentation to check token generation stalls.

matt: noted. looping in @qa so they can run the regression replay set against the canary results.

qa: got it — will validate replay scripts, compare token-level latencies and look for statistical regressions (ks-test / p95 shifts).

ana: great, thanks everyone. Action items: sam to run canary toggle (C-state + isolcpus), matt to collect perf.data if delta remains, qa to run regression checks. Will follow up with a short summary in #eng-runtime once we have perf artifacts. :thumbsup:
